about_the_game:
Welcome to FuMetaverse: Haunted Mansion VULKAN DEMO, the ultimate digital playground for creators and streamers! With its innovative technology that connects 3D virtual environments with real-time streaming and chat connectivity, FuMetaverse: Haunted Mansion VULKAN DEMOis a metaverse like no other.

In FuMetaverse: Haunted Mansion VULKAN DEMO, content creators can explore their very own haunted mansion and share it with their audiences. They can play mini-games (to come) to keep their viewers entertained, and customize their surroundings with personalized images, sounds (to come), and videos (to come). And with Twitch integration, streamers can easily connect with their chat and receive alerts while in-game.

But FuMetaverse: Haunted Mansion VULKAN DEMO isn't just for creators. Players of all levels can enjoy the unique features of the mansion.

Join the community today and experience the ultimate digital playground for yourself!

name: DreamVision Studio Demo

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5-6267U
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia™ 1060 6gb
  • Sound Card: integrated sound chip
  • Additional Notes: Needs a webcam with a good resolution and framerate (720p 30fps recommended)
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i7 6700k
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia™ 2060 8gb
  • Sound Card: integrated sound chip
  • Additional Notes: Needs a webcam with a good resolution and framerate (720p 30fps recommended)

short_description: "DreamVision Studio" is a Studio/World maker for content creators in real time that uses the webcam to generate an avatar that can interact with the customizable world. Comes with a complete set of features to select and andjust your camera.
